purpose: Direct written-algorithm diagnostics for subtraction and division, plus a dedicated addition-structure probe.

questions.prompt_en: There are 8 red counters and some blue counters. There are 13 counters altogether. What does 8 + □ = 13 tell you? Show the same relationship another way.
questions.prompt_cn: 有8个红色计数片和一些蓝色计数片，一共有13个。8+□=13表示什么？请用另一种方式表示同一个关系。
questions.expected_core: The unknown part is 5; the same relationship can be shown as 13-8=5 or with a part-whole model.
follow_ups: Which number is the whole? Which are the parts?

questions.prompt_en: In 402 - 178, why can one hundred be exchanged for ten tens, and then one ten for ten ones? Explain what stays the same.
questions.prompt_cn: 计算402-178时，为什么可以把1个百换成10个十，再把1个十换成10个一？请解释什么没有改变。
questions.expected_core: Each exchange changes the representation of the same quantity. Place value allows equivalent regrouping; the total value does not change.
follow_ups: Show the exchanges on a place-value chart.
Which written digits record these exchanges?

questions.prompt_en: When calculating 156 ÷ 12, what does each digit in a written quotient represent? Explain how a partial quotient or place-value model connects to the compact method.
questions.prompt_cn: 计算156÷12时，竖式商中的每个数字分别表示什么？请说明部分商或位值模型怎样与简写竖式对应。
questions.expected_core: Each quotient digit has a place value and represents groups of that size; the compact algorithm records decomposition and subtraction of multiples of the divisor.
follow_ups: Show one step with an area or grouping model.
